title: Wi-Fi priority
subtitle: Switch automatically between saved Wi-Fi networks in priority order.
credentialsHelp: To switch to protected Wi-Fi automatically, authorize the saved networks in one setup flow. macOS may ask separately for each network. WiFi Priority copies only those passwords into its own encrypted login Keychain entries and reads them silently for later connections. It never searches unrelated passwords or stores passwords in settings or logs or uploads them.
timingHelp: Checks the current Wi-Fi every 15 seconds. While connected to a backup, scans every 30 seconds and tries a higher-priority network after two consecutive sightings. After a failure it waits 5, 10, then 15 minutes, and retries every 15 minutes thereafter.
limitsHelp: An automatic join may briefly interrupt Wi-Fi. After a failure, the app tries to restore the previous connection. It checks Wi-Fi association, not internet access. Your manual choice of a network outside this list is respected.
scanFailed: Scan failed. Check Wi-Fi and Location access.
changed: Connection or settings changed. Checking again later.
cancelled: Switch cancelled. Keeping your current selection.
keepingRetry: Keeping {network}; failed networks will be retried later.
restored: Restored {network}; preferred networks will be retried after cooldown.
recoveryCancelled: Restore cancelled. Keeping your current selection.
cooldown: Connected: {network}. A failed network can be retried in about {minutes} min.
waiting: Waiting for an available network. Failed networks are on cooldown.
preview: Preview mode: no scanning or network switching
loadFailed: Settings could not be read. Auto-switching is paused. Save your network list again.
loginApproval: Allow WiFi Priority in Login Items in System Settings.
permissionFirst: Allow Location access, then scan again.
busy: A connection check is in progress. Try scanning again shortly.
permissionNeeded: Location access is needed to read Wi-Fi names
duplicate: This Wi-Fi network is already in the list.
invalidName: Enter a valid Wi-Fi name (1–32 bytes).
saveFailed: Could not save settings. Check available storage and permissions.
loginFailed: Could not change the login item. Check System Settings and keep the app in a fixed location.
locationUsage: Used to read Wi-Fi names and nearby networks for priority switching. Your geographic location is not requested or uploaded.
emptyList: Add the Wi-Fi networks you want to use, then save their order.
scanEmpty: No named Wi-Fi networks were found. Check Wi-Fi and Location access, or enter a saved network name.
testHelp: Pause auto-switching, select a network, then choose it in macOS Wi-Fi settings. The app checks the connected name for up to 2 minutes. macOS handles any password prompt and keeps your chosen connection.
pauseBeforeTest: Pause auto-switching before testing a Wi-Fi connection.
testPreview: Preview: no real connection was attempted.
testAlready: Already connected to {network}; the name matches.
testConnected: Connected to {network}. No previous Wi-Fi was connected, so this connection remains active.
testConnectedRestoreFailed: Connected to {network}, but could not restore {previous}. Check your current Wi-Fi.
testFailedPreviousAvailable: Could not connect to {network}. Your previous Wi-Fi {previous} is available. Check the exact name, saved password, and hotspot availability.
testFailedDisconnected: Could not connect to {network}. No previous Wi-Fi was connected. Check the exact name, saved password, and hotspot availability.
testFailedRestoreFailed: Could not connect to {network} or restore {previous}. Check Wi-Fi manually.
testCancelled: Connection test stopped. Check your current Wi-Fi.
testChanged: Wi-Fi changed during the test; keeping your manual selection.
testScanFailed: Could not scan for the target network. Check Wi-Fi and Location access.
testNetworkNotFound: The target network was not found. Check that the hotspot or hidden network is available.
testAssociationRejected: macOS rejected the connection (error {code}). Check the saved password and access point.
testTimedOut: The join was requested, but the target Wi-Fi was not confirmed in time.
hotspotHelp: For iPhone Instant Hotspot, choose Automatic under “Ask to join hotspots” in macOS Wi-Fi settings (macOS 26+). macOS auto-joins only when Wi-Fi is unavailable; this app cannot wake a dormant Instant Hotspot by custom priority.
shortcutUnavailable: macOS could not register this shortcut. It may conflict with a system or app shortcut; your previous shortcut is unchanged.
testSystemWaiting: Choose {network} in macOS Wi-Fi settings. Waiting for the connection…
testSystemConnected: macOS connected to {network}. The test passed; your chosen Wi-Fi stays connected.
testSystemTimedOut: No connection to {network} was detected within 2 minutes. Check the name and macOS Wi-Fi status.
testSystemCancelled: The system Wi-Fi test was stopped. Your current connection was not changed by the app.
testSystemOpenFailed: Could not open macOS Wi-Fi settings. Open it manually and try again.
shortcutHelp: Press Control with Option or Command plus a letter or number. Esc cancels; Delete clears.
shortcutInvalid: Use Control with Option or Command plus a letter or number.
credentialSetupRequired: The saved credential for {network} is unavailable. Set up Wi-Fi access to continue.
credentialConsentBody: WiFi Priority will request access only to the {count} Wi-Fi names below. macOS may show a separate authorization dialog for each saved password. Once approved, the app stores a copy in its own encrypted login Keychain item so future switches need no repeated prompt. Other Keychain passwords are not read. Passwords never go into settings or logs and are never uploaded. If a network password changes, use Refresh saved credentials.
credentialPrepared: Saved access for {count} networks. Automatic switching is on.
credentialPartial: Saved access for {count} networks. No saved password was found for {networks}. Open networks can still connect; for protected networks, connect in macOS Wi-Fi first, then set up access again.
credentialDenied: macOS did not authorize access to {network}. Automatic switching remains paused. Try the setup again and allow the macOS prompt.
credentialUnavailable: Could not prepare the saved credential for {network} (error {code}). Automatic switching remains paused.
credentialSetupFirst: Authorize saved Wi-Fi before enabling automatic switching.
credentialRemovalFailed: Could not remove the saved credential for {network} from the login Keychain (error {code}). You can remove that WiFi Priority item in Keychain Access.
